title: Zephyr: Rule 2 compression
description: Implement Rule 2 compression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: compresses IPv6/UDP, passes test vectors.
notes: Reconciled stale IPv6/UDP tracker wording against current Rule Set Version 3: wire Rule ID 2 is canonical link-local IPv6 + ICMPv6 Echo Request/Reply. Hardened Zephyr Rule 2 compression only: exact zero TC/flow, fe80::/64 endpoints, type 128/129 and code zero matching, ICMPv6 checksum validation, deterministic 176-bit/22-byte byte-aligned residue, opaque echo payload preservation, Rule 255 fallback without normalization, atomic output preflight, and 22554-byte profile ceiling. Added focused C request/reply canonical vectors, field/payload extremes, nonmatches, corrupt checksum, short buffer, and exact/over-profile tests. Validation: sanitizer-backed C PASS 1/1; Python Rule 2 PASS 566; Rust canonical/header tests PASS 2; Rules 3/4/7 C regressions PASS 5/5; cppcheck PASS.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated current-spec Zephyr SCHC Rule 2 compression
